card.name: Heart attack and search-rescue wording
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after heart-attack (myocardial infarction, post-MI) phrases, such as 'inf' in infarction, 'week' or 'days' after MI, and 'enzymes'. It also fires on 'search' or 'took' in search-and-rescue or debris passages.

modes.label: After myocardial infarction
modes.description: Time or lab words that follow a heart attack, or the start of the word infarction.
modes.example: IDs in the post-MI period were at increased risk of reinfarction, CV-related death, and all-cause mortality beginning in the first<< week>> of treatment.

modes.label: Search and rescue
modes.description: Words in passages about searching for debris or air search and rescue operations.
modes.example: generating a record number of accidents, demand was high for CAP’s leading role in domestic air search and rescue. War surplus aircraft helped jump-start post-war<< search>> operations.

card.writes: It pushes toward emergency, rescue, ambulance and recovery words, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It lights up in heart-attack follow-up wording and in search-and-rescue text, both about emergencies and recovery.
